title: Cherry blossoms in full bloom in Quzhou
text:
Cherry blossoms in full bloom in Quzhou
In Xinjiang village, Quzhou, Zhejiang province, nearly 20,000 cherry blossom trees have entered full bloom, with dozens of varieties flowering in succession.
The village has been transformed into a romantic sea of blossoms, with shades of pink and white, making it a popular destination for springtime outings.
Since late February, varieties such as Kawazu-zakura and Kanhi-zakura have been blooming in stages. The flowering period is expected to continue until mid-April.
Visitors strolling along village paths and floral trails are treated to the sight of swaying branches and a cascade of falling petals.
Cherry blossoms are in full bloom in Xinjiang village, attracting crowds of visitors. [Photo/WeChat account: kechengfabu]
The pink and white cherry blossoms create some stunning springtime scenery. [Photo/WeChat account: kechengfabu]
